tools.name: chmeetings_list_people
tools.description: List people (members and attendees) with optional filters on name, email, mobile, groups, gender, family role, creation date and contact preferences. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/people.

tools.name: chmeetings_get_person
tools.description: Get one person by id, with profile details. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_person_fields
tools.description: List the custom member fields defined for the account. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/people/fields.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_person_notes
tools.description: List the notes on one person. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/people/{person_id}/notes.

tools.name: chmeetings_create_person_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a new note to one person's profile. Existing notes are not changed. ChMeetings API: POST /api/v1/people/{person_id}/notes.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_groups
tools.description: List groups (ministries, teams, small groups). ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/groups.

tools.name: chmeetings_get_group
tools.description: Get one group by id. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/groups/{group_id}.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_group_people
tools.description: List the members of one or more groups (the union of their members). ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/groups/people.

tools.name: chmeetings_add_person_to_group
tools.description: WRITE: add one person to a group. ChMeetings API: POST /api/v1/groups/{group_id}/memberships.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_families
tools.description: List families with optional name search and paging. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/families.

tools.name: chmeetings_get_family
tools.description: Get one family and its members by id. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/families/{id}.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_events
tools.description: List events that fall within a date range (maximum 366 days). ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/events.

tools.name: chmeetings_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/events/{event_id}.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_event_occurrences
tools.description: List the dated occurrences of one event within a date range (maximum 366 days). ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/events/{event_id}/occurrences.

tools.name: chmeetings_get_occurrence
tools.description: Get one dated occurrence by id. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/occurrences/{occurrence_id}.

tools.name: chmeetings_get_attendance_summary
tools.description: Get the attendance totals for one occurrence. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/occurrences/{occurrence_id}/attendance/summary.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_attendance
tools.description: List the people for one occurrence with attended or absent status (paged). ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/occurrences/{occurrence_id}/attendance.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_follow_ups
tools.description: List follow-ups (pastoral and visitor follow-up tasks) with filters on status, type, person, assignee, action and scheduled date. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/follow-ups.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_follow_up_actions
tools.description: List the follow-up action types defined for the account. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/follow-ups/actions.

tools.name: chmeetings_create_follow_up
tools.description: WRITE: create a follow-up task for one person, assigned to at least one assignee (ids from the assignable-members list). Assignees with a user account are notified while it is pending. ChMeetings API: POST /api/v1/follow-ups.

tools.name: chmeetings_update_follow_up
tools.description: WRITE: update one follow-up (for example, set status to done). The API replaces the fields it receives, so pass person_id and assignee_ids again. ChMeetings API: PUT /api/v1/follow-ups/{follow_up_id}.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_contributions
tools.description: List giving records (contributions) with filters on person, date range, batch and reference. Financial data: read-only. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/contributions.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_contribution_funds
tools.description: List giving funds, with an optional tax-deductible filter. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/contributions/funds.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_campaigns
tools.description: List giving campaigns (pledge drives). ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/campaigns.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_campaign_pledges
tools.description: List the pledges made to one campaign. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/campaigns/{id}/pledges.

tools.name: chmeetings_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations (churches or sites) the API key can see. ChMeetings API: GET /api/v1/organizations.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chmeetings_list_people, chmeetings_create_follow_up · Private data: chmeetings_list_people, chmeetings_list_contributions, chmeetings_list_organizations · Public sink: chmeetings_list_people, chmeetings_create_person_note, chmeetings_add_person_to_group, chmeetings_create_follow_up.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chmeetings_list_people, chmeetings_create_follow_up · Private data: chmeetings_list_people, chmeetings_list_contributions, chmeetings_list_organizations · Public sink: chmeetings_list_people, chmeetings_create_person_note, chmeetings_add_person_to_group, chmeetings_create_follow_up

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
